questions.title: Snippet Comparison Count
questions.description: Searching the numbers 1..16 for the target 16, how many loop iterations happen? What does this print?
questions.codesnippet:
nums = list(range(1, 17))
target = 16
count = 0
lo, hi = 0, 15
while lo <= hi:
    count += 1
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    if nums[mid] < target: lo = mid + 1
    elif nums[mid] > target: hi = mid - 1
    else: break
print(count)
